cases.explain: The preposition «в» indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.translation: the Israelites began to commit fornication with the Moabite women
cases.explain: The preposition «с» (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: The people ate and bowed down to their gods
cases.explain: The verb «кланялся» (bowed down to) requires the dative case.
The verb «сказал» (said) takes the addressee in the dative case.

cases.translation: He ran both of them through with a spear
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the means or instrument of the action.

cases.translation: Take all the leaders of this people
cases.explain: The transitive verb «возьми» (take) takes a direct object; for animate nouns the accusative plural matches the genitive plural.

cases.sentence: он был вождем семьи из ___ Симеона
cases.translation: he was the leader of a family from the clan of Simeon
cases.explain: The preposition «из» (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: having deceived you in the matter of Peor
cases.explain: The preposition «с» (with) governs the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Народ ел и кланялся их богам.
reading.question: What did the people do?
options: Ate and bowed to their gods
reading.correct: Ate and bowed to their gods
reading.explain: The text says the people ate and bowed down to their gods.

reading.ru: Так Израиль сочетался с Баал-Пиором, и Господь разгневался на Израиль.
reading.question: Why did the Lord become angry?
reading.explain: The text says Israel joined Baal Peor and the Lord's anger burned.

reading.ru: Тогда мор среди израилетян прекратился, но погибших от него было 24 тысячи человек.
reading.question: How many died in the plague?
reading.explain: The text says those who died in the plague were 24,000.

reading.ru: А убитую мадианитянку звали Хазва, она была дочерью Цура, который был вождем рода, главой семьи в Мадиане.
reading.question: Who was Cozbi's father?
reading.explain: The text says the slain Midianite woman was the daughter of Zur.

reading.ru: Израилетянина, который был убит вместе с Мадианитянкой, звали Зимри, сын Салу, он был вождем семьи из рода Симеона.
reading.question: From which tribe was Zimri?
reading.explain: The text says Zimri was a leader of a family from the clan of Simeon.

reading.ru: В это время некий израилетянин привел в свою семью мадианитянку на глазах у Моисея и всего общества израилетян, когда они плакали у входа в шатер собрания.
reading.question: What was the congregation doing when the man brought the Midianite woman?
options: Weeping at the entrance of the tent
reading.correct: Weeping at the entrance of the tent
reading.explain: The text says they were weeping at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
